title: Patterns in art
examples: Teacher, how do I find the next shape?
Can we make a pattern with colours?
What is a pattern in art?

explain.say: Look at these shapes. They go circle, square, circle, square. Can you say that pattern for me?
Next, we look at colours. Blue, red, blue, red. The colours keep going in the same order.
Sometimes we mix shapes and colours. Triangle, blue, circle, red. It is a pattern with two things.
In real life, patterns are everywhere. Think about the stripes on a zebra. They repeat over and over.
If the pattern is big, like big shapes and big colours, we just keep repeating the group.
A common mistake is only looking at the last two things. You must look at the whole pattern group.

faq.q: What is a pattern in art?
faq.a: A pattern is when things repeat in an art piece. It makes the art look organized and fun.
asks: How do I spot a pattern?
What does repeating mean in art?

faq.q: Do I have to use the same shapes every time?
faq.a: No, you can use different shapes as long as they follow the same repeating rule. For example, big then small.
asks: Does the shape have to be the same?

faq.a: No, patterns can be shapes, colours, or both shapes and colours together. They can be anything that repeats.
asks: What if it is shapes and colours?

faq.q: How do I know where the pattern starts?
faq.a: You look at the beginning of the art piece to see the first group that repeats. This is the key to the pattern.
Sometimes patterns can be tricky, but you just need to look closely at the first few items to figure out the rule.

facts: Patterns help make art look balanced and neat.
You can find patterns in nature, like in leaves.
A pattern can repeat shapes, colours, or both.
The rule for the pattern is the group that repeats.

quiz.say: If the pattern is Red, Blue, Red, Blue, what colour comes next?
quiz.why: The pattern repeats the pair Red and Blue, so the next colour must be Red.

wrong.0: This is tempting because Blue was the colour just before the question mark.
wrong.1: This is tempting because you might think the colours are changing randomly.
wrong.2: This is tempting because you might try to put two things in one spot.

quiz.say: If the pattern is Circle, Square, Circle, Square, what shape comes next?
quiz.why: The pattern repeats the pair Circle and Square, so the next shape must be a Circle.

wrong.0: This is tempting because you might think a new shape starts the pattern.
wrong.1: This is tempting because you might write the whole next group.
wrong.3: This is tempting because the last shape shown was a Square.

quiz.say: If the pattern is Yellow, Green, Yellow, Green, what colour should be next?
quiz.why: The pattern repeats the pair Yellow and Green, so the next colour must be Yellow.

wrong.1: This is tempting because Green was the colour just before the question mark.
wrong.2: This is tempting because you might think a new colour starts the pattern.
wrong.3: This is tempting because you might write the whole next group.
